name: Brute Force SVO Construction
definition: A top-down octree construction method where the entire octree structure is built in memory, followed by a depth-first search to prune empty branches, resulting in a Sparse Voxel Octree.
summary: Brute Force SVO Construction is a top-down algorithm that builds a complete octree in memory and prunes empty branches, prioritizing implementation simplicity over memory efficiency and speed.
